items.title: CVS announces plan to split into 2 companies, stock sinks 10%
items.summary: CVS announced plans to separate into two independent, publicly traded companies on Wednesday, reshaping one of the largest healthcare companies in the US.

items.title: CVS scraps retail spin-off plans, reversing course on Aetna deal
items.summary: CVS (CVS) about-faces on its $70 billion Aetna merger strategy, scrapping plans to spin off its retail business. The decision marks a major shift for the healthcare giant as it rethinks its business model and the future of its pharmacy and insurance operations.

items.title: CVS to split into two companies in stunning strategic about-face
items.summary: The breakup, which will separate Aetna and Caremark from CVS’ retail pharmacies, is an indictment of the dogma that bigger is always better in the healthcare industry.

items.title: CVS Health Is Breaking Up. Is The Blue Wave To Blame?
items.summary: A Democratic Congress would have tried to force the breakup.

items.title: CVS to split into two companies, in major breakup of its $117 billion healthcare empire
items.summary: CVS Health said Wednesday it is splitting into two companies, marking one of the largest shakeups in the healthcare industry. It’s a major reversal of the mergers that brought together the nation’s largest drugstore retailer along with health insurance giant Aetna and pharmacy benefit manager Caremark.

items.title: CVS Splits In Two, The Morning After The Midterms
items.summary: The $78 billion Aetna marriage ends just as a new Democratic Congress gets the keys
